steps_raw.instruction: Post Patch Clamp Slice Fixation
Scope and Applicability: Process to fix recorded/filled cells from mouse and human brain slices with 4% PFA/2.5% Glutaraldehyde in PBS for future histochemical processing.
#0 Paintbrush (Ted Pella 11810)
1.7 ml Microfuge tubes (Olympus Plastics 224-282 or equivalent)
1000 µl pipette tip (Rainin GP-L1000F or equivalent)
20 µl microloader tip (Eppendorf 930001007)
24 well plate (Costar CLS3524 or equivalent)
24 well plate insert (Pelco 36172)
4% Paraformaldehyde/2.5% Glutaraldehyde in PBS (SOP RP0229)
ACSF.III (SOP RP0220)
Biocytin (Sigma B4261)
Forceps (Roboz RS-5045)
Patch-Seq Internal Solution (SOP RP0235)
Mouse (SOP AF0099) or human (SOP PF0295) brain slices in ACSF.III
3 ml plastic Pasteur pipette (BD Falcon 357575), tip cut off
Petri dish (100 mm outside diameter)
AirClean 600 Workstation
AirClean 600 Workstation
Fixed brain slices in PBS with target cell(s) used for electrophysiology recordings filled with Biocytin for downstream staining.

Warning: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what PPE you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.
Obtain tissue slices prepared following SOP AF0099 or PF0295.
Set-up for Patch-seq using Patch-Seq Recording and Extraction SOP PF0301.
Obtain fresh 4% PFA/2.5% Glutaraldehyde per SOP RP0229 and fresh PBS per SOP RP0001.
Fill ice bucket with wet ice to be used to keep the Biocytin Solution chilled.
Use label maker to label a 24 well plate (without insert) “EPhys_YYMMDD_plate#”. Place the 24 well plate in the AirClean hood.
Human tissue should go in a separate PFA/Glut plate, labeled the same way as the mouse PFA/Glut plates, but with a note for human tissue only.
Fill each well of a second 24 well plate (w/ plate insert) with ~1 ml 1X PBS(-). Fill through the insert to ensure that the well gets filled properly.

Use label maker to label insert with the plate name “EPhys_YYMMDD_plate#” on the flat edge of the insert. This plate can go on the shaker tray in the fridge if not adding fixed slices to it from the previous day/week for staining (Figure 1).
Human tissue should go in a separate PBS plate from mouse tissue.
Methodology/Procedures:
After recording from a neuron according to the Patch-Seq Recording and Extraction SOP PF0301, pull the pipette away from the cell diagonally until a GΩ seal forms.
Switch to the “Approach” setting on the control cube (Figure 2).
Slowly pull away from the cell in the X direction.
Place your finger inside one of the grooves on the control cube, move your index finger counter-clockwise completing roughly one revolution every five seconds.
If finished patching in the slice, remove the harp from on top of the cell and allow the cell to rest for 10 minutes.

Fill the next empty well of the appropriate (mouse vs. human) PFA/Glut plate with ~500 µl of 4% PFA/2.5% Glutaraldehyde. Use the Pasteur pipette to transfer the slice from the stage to the well. (Note that human and mouse tissue will go into different PFA/Glut plates).
Write the specimen ID, as well as your initials, on the lid of the PFA/Glut plate above the well occupied by the slice. (Figure 3).
Once through recording for the day, place the 24 well plate with slices in 4% PFA/2.5% Glutaraldehyde on the orbital shaker tray in the 4°C fridge.

When recording after hours, as typical for human tissue, the PFA/Glut plate should be kept in the 4°C fridge the entire time and only removed when transferring slices to prevent the plate getting left out overnight at room temperature.
After slices have fixed for 2 days (>40hrs), transfer slices from the PFA/Glut plate to the corresponding well in the PBS plate.

Ideally, slices are fixed for two days and transferred to PBS the following morning, but can be transferred up to four days later without issue (in the case of a weekend or holiday weekend). Ensure all slices are adequately submerged in PBS.
When all slices have been transferred to PBS, empty the PFA/Glut plate(s) into the PFA waste bottle in the AirClean hood using a funnel.
Technical Information:
4% PFA + 2.5% Glutaraldehyde used for patch clamp slice fixation has a shelf life of 8 days when stored at 4ºC.
50% Glutaraldehyde stock solution should be stored at 4ºC.
Preparation of Internal Solution/Biocytin mix. (Note: only required if pre-made solution is not available).
Obtain a tube of Internal Solution from the -20ºC freezer.
If Biocytin powder has not already been weighed out into a microfuge tube, weigh out between 4 and 5 mg of Biocytin into a microfuge tube using a balance.
Determine how much Internal Solution to add to the Biocytin powder:
Example: To make a 1% Internal Solution/Biocytin mix, weigh 4.2 mg of Biocytin and add 420 µl of Internal Solution to the Biocytin tube.
Vortex the tube until all the Biocytin is dissolved into solution.
Put the tube of Biocytin internal mix in the ice bucket and cover the bucket with the lid.
